reason: One host-lifetime contract test module shares a small synthetic session/fetch harness and real QueryClient to exercise explicit connect, idle expiry, suspension/revocation and cache-generation ownership. These are the states of one ActionHostController plus its injected journal, not separate feature domains. Splitting at431 nonblank lines would duplicate the same authority/observation fixtures; all executable test cases and helpers remain below80 lines.

The describe declaration groups explicit connection-lifetime examples: no automatic connection, exact hints, duplicate prevention, late bootstrap disposal, StrictMode remount, idle expiry and native refusal. Each example independently observes host snapshots, request counts or timers; the group is not an oversized executable handler and contains no policy/provider implementation.

The describe declaration groups the journal boundary of the same host: exact authority-key isolation, uncertain-state remount retention, absence of credentials/wires in cache, and old-generation write exclusion after canonical clearing. It uses the real QueryClient and adapter fixtures; assertions test retained or forbidden effects rather than reimplementing the journal algorithm.
